newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government bonds close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government bonds close slightly higher.

text.p: Singapore government bond prices closed slightly higher across the board on interbank and retail interest, dealers said on Monday.
"Bond prices were marked up slightly today as the interbank rate eased slightly. Treasury bill yields were slightly lower and volume was moderate," a local dealer said.

Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$98.52/98.57 compared with last Friday's close of S$98.48/98.53, September 2001 at S$97.26/97.31 against S$97.15/97.20 and June 2003 at S$95.26/95.31 from S$95.15/95.20.
The overnight interbank offered rate eased to 2-7/8 2-2/4 percent versus last Friday's 3-1/8 3 percent.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.82/1.77 percent against last Friday's yield of 1.90/1.85 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.03/1.98 percent from 2.07/2.02 percent.
